caption: The video captures a twilight sky dominated by faint greenish-blue aurora bands over a purple-to-pink gradient near the horizon. A small bright star holds its position near the center, while a black silhouette of leafy branches and a roofline anchors the right and lower-right edge. Across the upper and left portions, the auroral streaks keep a steady arrangement, with the horizontal banding and diagonal rays showing no clearly visible drift or change of shape over this short span. The brighter curtain-like patch in the upper-right area shows no clearly visible rippling or movement, its outline and brightness looking broadly steady rather than translating as a single object. The overall sky color and foreground position stay persistent, indicating a static view of the aurora, whose structure appears essentially unchanged throughout the visible span.
